copy.promotionalText: Explore Mcaulee Maddison’s SkyPulse: twelve Endless Route worlds, four fresh Pulse Relay circuits each UTC day, and eight Blackout Protocol cipher sectors.
copy.description:
SkyPulse Arcade is Mcaulee Maddison’s mechanical-bird and cipher-puzzle arcade: three free offline modes with their own scenery, controls and progress.

ENDLESS ROUTE
Tap to flap, thread the gates and collect crystals as you chase your best. Travel from Neon City through Aurora Rise and Solar Drift to Cobalt Storm, Amber Skies and Polar Glow. Twelve environments change every 15 gates before the route repeats.

PULSE RELAY
Fly four fresh daily circuits through an orbital station. Collect faceted, numbered crystals to open their matching gates automatically. Follow the illuminated approach, pass each aperture and reach the green exit to earn a medal. Spare crystals improve your medal. Each UTC day brings new named routes. Today’s routes and medals remain stable across app restarts. Use a single tap-to-flap control, then choose Next Mission after a clear.

BLACKOUT PROTOCOL
Plan a route through eight increasingly demanding lattice puzzles. Tap connected neighbours, recover every core and reach the uplink before trace runs out. Ice and violet keys open matching locks; phase switches change mint and amber routes. Firewalls auto-breach for one charge and three trace, then a second tap enters. Blocked moves and failed breaches cost trace and can lose the sector. Each clear saves and activates the next sector immediately.

DAILY MISSION CONTROL
Complete four tasks across your attempts and claim five crystals for each, up to 20 daily-task crystals per UTC day. The daily reset time appears in your local time zone.

BUILD YOUR COLLECTION
Earn crystals to unlock 15 cosmetic birds with equal flight handling. Nine Tech Tree nodes, each with three levels, improve the Endless Route collection and reward effects shown in the game. Mission medals and Endless best are saved separately.

THREE MODES, THREE HOMES
Home starts on Endless Route. Tap the top-left badge to select a free mode. Each Home has its own scenery, animation, progress and relevant controls: flight collection, Relay circuits and cosmetic Hangar, or Blackout sector map and field guide.

Return to the selected mode’s Home with Main Menu after each run. Portrait play on iPhone and iPad, with Reduced Motion and haptic controls. Play offline with no advertising, account or real-money purchases. Progress and preferences are saved on your device.
copy.reviewNotes:
SkyPulse Arcade — current private candidate 1.0.0 (11)

REVIEW HOLD
The developer has withdrawn public submission while awaiting Apple's specific similarity comparison and clarification of the terminated-account reference. This saved draft does not request review. Build 11 is selected in this saved draft. The product copy describes build 11; physical-device validation and matching current screenshots/video remain required before future submission.

BUILD 11 WALKTHROUGH
1. Home starts on Endless Route. Its top-left badge opens the three free modes. Each Home has its own animated environment, progress and relevant controls. Blackout has its sector map and field guide, without Bird Hangar or Tech Tree.
2. Endless Route: tap the playable area to flap, pass gates and collect crystals. Twelve environments change every 15 gates. Fifteen birds share flight handling; unlocks are cosmetic. Nine Tech Tree nodes have three levels each. The developer requested slightly wider pipe spacing and slightly smaller gaps for build 11.
3. Pulse Relay: four named, bounded circuits refresh each UTC day, with two to five gates. Tap to flap. Faceted numbered crystals open only their matching gate automatically; the opening animation cannot delay passage. There are no FLAP/PULSE buttons. Today's routes and medals survive restarts. A successful mission offers Next Mission directly when another daily circuit remains.
4. Blackout Protocol: eight increasingly hard authored sectors. Tap connected neighbours, recover every core and reach the uplink. Ice/violet keys and mint/amber phase routes add constraints. Tapping a closed firewall spends one breach charge and three trace; tap again to enter. Wrong moves and failed breaches cost trace. Exhaustion fails the sector. Completion saves once and activates the next sector immediately; held input cannot carry into it. The final sector uses the campaign result flow.
5. Main Menu is available after results in all modes. Four daily tasks award five crystals each, at most 20 per UTC day, with separate claim recovery. Existing Endless saves and the earned-crystal economy remain compatible.

VALIDATION
Build 11 is signed and Testing in the existing SkyPulse Internal group. Fourteen automated Unity QA markers passed; recorded hashes link the nineteen runtime scripts to the tested/exported source. Archive identity, privacy manifest, bundled branded links and current metadata checks passed. Fresh physical build 11 gameplay/performance validation remains pending. Existing build 7 screenshots/video are historical and must be replaced before public submission.

DEVELOPMENT AND ARTWORK
Mcaulee Maddison created this project with AI coding assistance. He confirms ARTA and ChatGPT artwork, a lifetime ARTA purchase, and references from his own images/generated outputs. Published output terms support use subject to their conditions; provider assignment/use permissions are not a claim of exclusive copyright. All 145 Unity source images have current hashes and origin evidence entries. Specific built-in image-tool records remain separate from broad ARTA statements. Five sound effects are synthesized from retained source without input samples. Unity components retain their respective rights.

The owner states no prior submission/supply through another developer account, publisher, contractor or purchased template. The local audit identified no imported game template or unrelated identity. Apple's private comparator has not been identified; this audit does not declare its allegation resolved.
